Package index

Bayesian AMMI

Priors, the Gibbs sampler of Crossa et al. (2011) and the biplot with HPD regions.

bam_priors() print(<bam_priors>)
Prior distributions of the Bayesian AMMI model
bayes_ammi()
Bayesian estimation of the AMMI and GGE models
biplots()
Biplots with highest posterior density regions

Decisions for breeders

Predictions, winners, probabilities of superior performance and stability, ranks and stability measures.

bam_predict()
Predictions of every genotype-environment cell
bam_winners()
Which genotype wins where: posterior probabilities
bam_superiority()
Probabilities of superior performance and stability
bam_ranks()
Posterior distribution of the ranks of the genotypes
bam_stability()
Bayesian stability of the genotypes

Bayesian stability analysis

Finlay-Wilkinson, Eberhart-Russell and Shukla models; posterior distributions of stability indices.

bayes_stability()
Bayesian stability analysis: Finlay-Wilkinson, Eberhart-Russell and Shukla models
bam_stab_priors()
Priors of the Bayesian stability models
bam_indices()
Posterior distributions of classical stability indices
bam_ammi_indices()
Posterior distributions of AMMI-based stability indices

Model choice

DIC and WAIC, posterior predictive checks and draws for posterior, bayesplot and coda.

bam_compare()
Compare Bayesian AMMI and GGE models
bam_ppc()
Posterior predictive checks
as_draws_df(<bam_bayes_ammi>) as_draws(<bam_bayes_ammi>) as.mcmc.list(<bam_bayes_ammi>)
The draws of a fit for posterior, bayesplot and coda
